explication: nopCommerce is an ASP.NET Core e-commerce platform. A customer-facing request enters the web application, where customer/account and shopping-cart or checkout features lead to store capabilities such as catalog, orders, payment, tax, and shipping; administrators manage products and reviews separately. The repository also defines content, localization, security, and plugin extension capabilities. The excerpts show selected controller-to-service and framework-to-engine references, but not the complete checkout or persistence call chain, so those broader relationships are documented at capability level rather than asserted as exact calls.
